bodyText.heading: Learn German in the capital city of North Rhine Westphalia
bodyText.text: Do you want to study, work, and live in Germany? Learning German in an intensive course is the best way to acquire the language quickly and efficiently. Good German skills open the door to free university education, the German job market, better career opportunities, and therefore to success! Our German intensive courses enable fast language acquisition as well as an intensive refresh and expansion of your German skills. You can book the German intensive course as a standard course with 4 lessons per day or as an intensive course/educational leave option with 6 lessons per day. In addition, both course types include access to our online Learning Management System (LMS) to practice learning content in a targeted way. This is how long it typically takes to complete one proficiency level in one of our German standard or intensive courses: A1: 8 weeks B2: 10 -12 weeks A2: 8 weeks C1: 10 -12 weeks B1: 8 -10 weeks C2: 10 -12 weeks

bodyText.heading: When can I start an intensive German course at GoAcademy! IH Düsseldorf?
bodyText.text: Our intensive German courses in Düsseldorf (levels A1–C2) run continuously, and it is possible to join an ongoing course any Monday. Our intensive German courses consist of groups of 6 to 14 participants. For absolute beginners (A0), we recommend starting on the official course date, which is always the first Monday of the month.

bodyText.heading: Why should I attend a German intensive course at GoAcademy! IH Düsseldorf?
bodyText.text: For more than 30 years, GoAcademy! IH Düsseldorf has been offering future-oriented German courses for private individuals and companies in addition to regular German classes, helping to improve training and further education opportunities as well as career prospects both in Germany and abroad. Our language school in Düsseldorf has been continuously recognized as a leading provider of continuing education from 2021 to 2025. We are also AZAV-accredited by TÜV Rheinland and certified according to DIN EN ISO 9001:2015. Additionally, GoAcademy! is part of the global networks of the International House World Organisation and IALC language schools, which are audited annually to ensure and maintain the high quality standards of their courses.

bodyText.heading: Learn German in Düsseldorf at GoAcademy!
bodyText.text: You will benefit from the vibrant, international city of Düsseldorf while learning in a professional, practice-oriented environment at GoAcademy! that enables rapid progress.

bodyText.heading: Why learn German in Düsseldorf?
bodyText.text: Düsseldorf, the capital of the federal state of North Rhine-Westphalia, is an open-minded city with numerous universities, international companies, galleries, museums, and a wide range of leisure activities. The city on the Rhine offers an attractive mix of business, culture, and sports. It is also internationally known for its fashion fair, the exclusive shopping street Königsallee, its old town, and its wide variety of culinary options. Thanks to its ideal location within Germany, famous European capitals such as Paris, Amsterdam, or Brussels can be reached within a few hours by train or car. Düsseldorf International Airport makes arrival easy for participants from all over the world. Learning German in Düsseldorf is an ideal opportunity not only to master the German language effectively but also to connect with people from different cultures, discover new places, and broaden your horizons. At GoAcademy!, we ensure that your learning experience while studying German is both successful and enriching.

bodyText.heading: GoAcademy! — Accommodation for Language Students
bodyText.text: GoAcademy! offers various accommodation options for its international language students. Accommodation can be booked in combination with a German standard intensive course or a German intensive course. We are happy to help you choose the right accommodation — whether in a room in one of our shared apartments, with a host family, or in a hotel. With us, you will quickly feel at home. You can find more information here: Accommodation SIGN UP NOW →

bodyText.heading: About us
bodyText.text: GoAcademy! ist seit 1990 eine der führenden Sprachschulen in Europa. Wir bieten neben Sprachkursen für Privatpersonen und Firmen auch Sprachreisen in 40 verschiedene Länder an. Spaß am Lernen ist wesentlicher Bestandteil unseres Konzeptes. Deshalb gestalten unsere erfahrenen und qualifizierten Trainer den Unterricht lebendig und kommunikativ.„Unsere Philosophie, die auf der Vermittlung von Sprache als integriertem Bestandteil einer Kultur beruht, ist die Grundlage von nachhaltigem Verstehen, konstruktiver Kommunikation und erfolgreicher Zusammenarbeit.“Michael Rönitz, Geschäftsführer
